subtitle: Your teams. One baseball hub.
description: Follow the teams you care about in one focused baseball companion. Hub Ball brings together live scores, box scores, schedules, standings, player statistics, curated headlines, public social posts, prediction-market links, and visual stories built from baseball history. Choose a team and move between the information that matters without creating an account. Hub Ball is an independent, unofficial fan app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Major League Baseball or any MLB club.
review_notes: Hub Ball is an unofficial multi-team baseball companion with live scores, box scores, schedules, standings, player statistics, curated headlines, public social posts, prediction-market links, and visual historical stories. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Major League Baseball or any MLB club. Live and published baseball data is delivered through the app's HTTPS backend. No account or login is required. The Markets screen links to third-party market pages; users cannot place wagers in the app.
